# Cargo: name the feed as a registry (.cargo/config.toml)
# A sparse index (Cargo 1.68 and later). Nothing comes from it unless a dependency names it with registry =.
[registries.polaris-key]
index = "sparse+https://pkg.plrs.im/cargo/polaris-key/"

# Depend on the crate from this registry (Cargo.toml)
[dependencies]
<crate> = { version = "*", registry = "polaris-key" }
